title: A clicking membrane
hook: Some insect sounds begin with a body surface moving.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The second panel shows a ribbed tymbal changing curvature, a simplified representation of the structure used in cicada sound production. Actual calls involve repeated movements and species-dependent anatomy; this is not an audio measurement.

misconception: All insect calls are made by rubbing legs together.
objective: In the cicada schematic, which motion is associated with producing its call?

claims.text: Some insect sounds begin with a body surface moving. In the cicada schematic, which motion is associated with producing its call? options: It is made by rubbing two forewings
